title: Ligeia
identity: Frederick Speck’s *Ligeia* is listed in the Dorn Publications catalog as item 195, for alto saxophone and piano in the current catalog. A Florida State University reel-to-reel archive lists a 1989 Festival of New Music performance entry for alto saxophone and piano, but the performer is not identified in the surfaced record.
